verdict.rationale: The documented App API sends and triggers broadcasts, but Customer.io's own docs say the broadcast must first be set up in the UI and then triggered with a single call. That fails the story's 'without touching the dashboard' requirement for the REST API. Creating automations and one-time sends without the UI is claimed only through the MCP server and the CLI, which are aimed at AI agents and scripts, and neither has documented endpoint-level detail. Missing for 10: a documented REST endpoint to create campaigns or broadcasts from scratch (content, audience, schedule), explicit API-based scheduling of send times, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the MCP/CLI creation path works end-to-end.
